note: website_slides drops to zero offenders. 135 -> 130. Five `_fetch_*` definitions renamed to the canonical `_get_*` (_get_external_metadata, _get_youtube_metadata, _get_google_drive_metadata, _get_vimeo_metadata, _get_thumbnail) and `_ensure_quiz_survey` to `_check_quiz_survey`. Renamed rather than baselined because two of the offenders were new code added in the same change: raising the floor to admit them would have made the gate pay for its own violation. Nothing outside addons/website_slides references any of the six -- verified by grep across odoo/addons, enterprise and agromarin -- so the rename is confined to the module. An exact ratchet fails in the falling direction too, which is why the reduction is banked here.
